# Tan Salon Insurance

> Insurance for tanning salons and personal appearance businesses, insuring personal appearance services since 1973. Tanning coverage has no cancer exclusions.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.tansaloninsurance.com/): coverage overview, who we insure, FAQ
- [Free quote questionnaire](https://www.tansaloninsurance.com/personal-appearance-questionaire/): request a free quote

## Key facts
- Insures: Barbers, Cosmetologists, Estheticians, Massage Therapists, Booth Rentals, Independent Contractors, Beauty Schools, Manicurists, Tanning Salons, Including Spray-On and Airbrush Tanning
- Coverage: general and professional liability, property, umbrella (up to $10,000,000), commercial auto
- Payment: automatic bank draft monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual; Mastercard, Visa, Discover, American Express
